name: Pork Tacos with Roasted Veggies, Fresh Salsa & Lime Crema

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and halve onions. Mince half and place in a small bowl; set aside. Thinly slice remaining onion and divide between the baking sheets.

Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into strips; add bell pepper and corn to the baking sheets with the sliced onion. Sprinkle veggies with half of the spice mix and drizzle with oil; toss to combine. (Reserve remaining spice mix for the pork.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup frozen corn
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Spread veggies out in an even layer. Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until softened, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest limes into another small bowl; add yogurt, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the lime crema and set aside. (Reserve limes for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the reserved limes into the bowl with minced onion; cut the remaining limes into wedges and set aside for serving.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with onion and lime juice along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat pork chops dry with paper towels, then thinly slice into bite-sized strips. Place in the bowl with remaining spice mix, and toss to coat.

Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with pork, veggies, and cheese. Serve with fresh salsa, lime crema, and lime wedges. Enjoy!
